blocks.text: Let's look at this one. Which of these are like terms of five x? Choose all that apply.
blocks.display: Select all the like terms of 5x.

blocks.text: Negative three x. The variable part is x, the same as in five x. A like term.
x. That is one x, with the same variable part. A like term.
Five x squared. Same number, but x squared is not x. The exponents are different, so it is not a like term.
Five y. It has the same number, but a different variable. Not a like term.
Five. This is a constant with no variable, so it is not like five x.
Two of them are like terms of five x: negative three x and x. Like terms have exactly the same variable part. The number in front does not matter.
